digestScope: git-listed app files excluding markdown and docs; paths plus NUL plus bytes, sorted
coverage: malformed JSON and invalid shapes preserve original bytes for every mutation
storage read and write failures with retry
mixed concurrent add edit delete preserves other records
native errors do not touch fallback
failed refresh retains notes and both drafts
failed writes and deletion retain visible notes and recover
stale refresh cannot replace newer edit or newer refresh
initial load guards premature writes without losing draft
active editor survives search and refresh omission
limitations: SecureStore queue serializes one JavaScript runtime, not multiple processes
Fault injection proves application behavior, not device storage hardware reliability
